points.description: States that in a circular linked list the last element (node) points back to the head/first node of the list (rather than to null as in a basic linked list).
points.partial_credit: Award 2–3 marks if the answer says the list is circular/loops or connects in a cycle but does not clearly say the last node links to the head/first node, or only says the basic list ends in null.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the last node links back to the first/head node, in any wording, however brief. Part marks for a vague or half-right answer, e.g. it forms a loop or cycle, or the basic list ends in null without saying where the circular one points. No marks for unrelated differences (e.g. doubly linked, speed, memory) that omit the last-to-head link. Extra correct or minor wrong remarks do not cost marks unless they contradict the core idea.
